reasons: The cited text supports the compliant status: § 8.2 provides successive twelve-month (not multi-year) automatic renewals with a Customer-only opt-out on thirty days' written notice — well inside the preferred ≤ 30-day window — plus a Vendor reminder sixty days before renewal and an extension of the opt-out deadline if the reminder is missed.
§ 8.3 caps renewal uplift at the lesser of CPI and three percent with ninety days' notice and no increase on prepaid periods, matching the preferred ≤ lesser of CPI and 3 % cap.

The failing deterministic check ('number not found') is a false negative caused by the notice period being spelled out in words ('thirty days'); the paragraph text plainly satisfies the ≤ 60-day (and ≤ 30-day preferred) threshold.
Rationale correctly distinguishes § 8.1's fixed three-year initial term from an automatic multi-year renewal, so no walk-away trigger applies.
No redline or comment is expected or offered for a compliant finding, and none was proposed — consistent with retaining this as internal evidence rather than a negotiation issue.
